Extra efficiency extra thickens: Each coaster measures 4 inches in diameter, and is ideal for absorbing drips, spills, and condensation to protect your tabletops, furniture, and countertops; The drink holder cork material is thick enough to absorb liquids and shocks, but not too thick that the coaster becomes cumbersome; These drink coasters for tabletop protection are liquid-wicking and heat-resistant too so you can place various cups or small pots, hot or cold, without damaging the surfaces;

Never out of style: Our set of 16 cork coasters with holder offer the perfect balance of spills protection and a classic look that never goes out of style; Experience the functionality and minimalistic design of these coasters for drinks, absorbent, with holder; Their simple round design and cork stone pattern look great against nearly any style of furniture, apartment décor, boho living room decor, office, bar or restaurant;

Practical housewarming gift: Including 16 ⅕ inches coasters for the coffee table and a metal holder, this set of simple, yet cool coasters can be easily included in the house warming presents for the new home category you always must have in mind; These cup coasters are also great home essentials for a new apartment, office, bar or restaurant, ideal to have on hand when hosting a party with more people; Additional, the remarkable packaging design helps you save time and effort when wrapping it;

All-purpose coasters: Featuring a warm, minimal look, the drink coasters are very useful and they are also super-functional, ideal to be used for coffee cups, wine glasses, mugs, beer bottles, small pots, small plants, and DIY art projects; They also reduce noise from glasses and mugs; A black coasters holder, with round edges, keeps them neat, tidy and all in one place when they’re not actively in use; These cork coasters are also easy to clean, just wipe off the spills with a damp cloth;
